messages:
Priya: ok folks — thinking of a 'silent artist' brunch: paint canvases + low-key brunch (mimosas optional). Saturday 11am? @channel who's in? 🎨🥐 React with 👍 = in, 👀 = maybe, ❌ = can't make. Any dietary prefs?

DevBot: FYI — team events budget code TEAM-EVENTS-24. Please note bookings need approval if > $200.

Maya: love this! can we have a non-alcoholic mimosa option pls. and maybe smaller canvases? i'm bad at big ones :sweat_smile:

Jordan: i can check Aster Cafe — they have a private back room, holds ~15, brunch platters + painting kit option. i'll DM them now. :phone:

Liam: sketch pads as option please. canvases intimidate me too 😅

Sofia: i'm in! gf here — happy to bring gf pastries. who is keeping the RSVP list?

Priya: thanks all. @Jordan please confirm price and whether they can do a GF platter. i'll collect RSVPs here. if ✳️ deposit needed i'll handle & expense it. pls react to the original message so i can tally quickly.

Jordan: update — Aster quoted $18/person (painting kit + shared brunch platter), mimosas = cash bar. they can do GF platter if we pre-order. need a 50% deposit to hold the space.

Maya: $18 sounds good to me. non-alc mimosa ok?

Liam: 👍

Sofia: 👍 (i can pay the deposit back to Priya)

Jordan: reserved tentatively for 12; will confirm once deposit's sorted. they want confirmation by Friday EOD.

Priya: sweet — plan: I'll collect deposit via Venmo/ACH tonight, confirm w/Aster tomorrow AM. Current in = Priya, Maya, Liam, Sofia, Jordan (5). Anyone else want in? Deadline to say yes = Thu 5pm. I'll post final headcount after Thu.

Maya: tagging @everyone IRL: i'll bring extra brushes and spare paper for those sketching.

DevBot: Event created in calendar: "Silent Artist Brunch" Sat 11:00 — invite sent to confirmed list (pending Priya's final).
